im:name.label: Bus Times - This is the Place

summary.label:
THIS IS THE PLACE is a bus transport app for Hong Kong and Singapore. It provides real-time bus arrival information, route planning, and point-to-point routing. In Hong Kong, it supports KMB, Citybus, Green Minibus, MTR Bus, and New Lantau Bus. The app also includes route maps for the MTR, light rail, and tram in Hong Kong, as well as the MRT route map in Singapore. It is also a weather app, allowing users to check the weather forecast for any location in the world and mark their favorite cities on a 3D globe. Additionally, it has a location search function, enabling users to find nearby toilets around the world or select one of the following maps for Hong Kong: libraries, cinemas, "parks, zoos & gardens", museums, or children's play rooms. 

THIS IS THE PLACE answers two big questions about bus travel:
1. Bus arrival time
2. All the places that can be reached by nearby buses

HOW TO USE:
1. Determine the departure location and range, and start exploring
2. Find the destination you are interested in among the places you can go directly without changing buses
3. On the How to Get There page, bookmark the departure stop of a route
4. Open favorites and see the bus arrival time

You can also search for route numbers directly.

THE IDEA
Using spider radiation technology to achieve the effect of true octopus, it is like sitting on a slide to reach a place directly. Relatively speaking, it is an instant movement that civilians can do. The app is also like an Anywhere Door around you, scanning the places that you can reach directly, to help you explore the world. Radiation map of the bus network.

PUBLIC TRANSIT INDEX (Exclusive and Original)
Refers to the total number of all destinations that can be reached directly from one place without changing buses - check it out before you buy or rent a house. One value compares the accessibility of different places!

NEW WORLD
It turns out that nearby buses can go to these places. Discover new routes, and reach places that you didn't know you could get to before.

UNCOVERING THE FOG
- Bookmark the departure stops for your next visit. You can also sort them by distance, with the nearest one displayed in front.
- Travel directions: Before going to a place, in addition to exploring the direct route in THIS IS THE PLACE, you can also explore the transportation of the destination, and bookmark the stop that you can return from.

OUT OF BODY
Float to any place on the map you are interested in, explore, and press the My Location button in the top right corner to return your mind to your body.

NOTIFICATIONS
- At work/home/waiting for a bus: Show departure/boarding reminder a few minutes in advance
- Get off alert: "The stop is almost here! Get ready to get off!"

TRAFFIC
Show traffic congestion on the map.

STEPS
THIS IS THE PLACE integrates with the Health app, it allows you to display today's walking steps or distance in the corner of the map to see if you've reached your walking goal today, so you can easily decide to take a ride or walk to your destination.

P.S.
Offline use support! (except arrival time)
You can use it without GPS! (Touch and hold the map to locate)
So fast!
